summary: The 8-K/A filed by Apollo IG Core Replacement, L.P. corrects a prior 8-K by removing Item 3.02 disclosure about issuance of unregistered limited partnership interests, clarifying those interests were issued by a parallel fund and not the registrant. The filing also reports amendments to the partnership agreement adding aggregator entities to the fund structure (effective June 30, 2026) and discloses NAV as of May 31, 2026 of $1,836.8 million. There is no special-situation event; these are routine fund administrative and structural updates.
